'''December 2001 Pennsylvania tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Twilight Games, Pennsylvania on 15 December 2001. [[Drew Scott]] won it. It is known from Rypcord Kline's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3177">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cansd3177/ twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cans], DeckTech (Rypcord "Rypcord" Kline, 16 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cansd3177/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Twilight Games, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Scott]]
